laneSummary: Five Vermont sealing families repaired together through their one shared host, scripts/build-census-v1-vt_seal_misdemeanor-set.mjs. Two repairs in one rebuild: the boundary participant's full legal name now fits field 34d of 200-00132 on packet page 3 (an existing, default-off finalizer option, alignWidgetFontSizeToFit, opted into at the host's single call site — no shared module was edited and no font size was hand-set), and the four families that carried none of their declared self-help stop conditions now carry all of them, verbatim from the committed track registry, through the code path vt_seal_pardon-set already used. Raster on the new bytes and independent verification are still owed.

rows.claim: node scripts/grade-a-packet-factory-24h/claim.mjs --assert FIX75 vt_seal_18_to_21-set -> CLAIM_OK FIX75 vt_seal_18_to_21-set (repair, grant set a2bba26e25b8c21f), exit 0. Asserted before any artifact of this family was edited.

whatChanged.sharedHost: scripts/build-census-v1-vt_seal_misdemeanor-set.mjs — the one host all five families are built by. No shared module was edited: scripts/rcap-official-forms/rcap-official-form-finalize.mjs and scripts/rcap-official-forms/rcap-text-fitting.mjs are untouched.
whatChanged.knownPrefills: alignWidgetFontSizeToFit: true added at the host's single finalizeOfficialForm call, beside the evaluateDeclaredMinimumSize, suppressSynthesizedAppearances and fitAppearancesToRect that were already there. The option is the finalizer's own, default-off, and rewrites only the size token inside each widget's existing /DA, so a widget whose declared size already equals the fit is left alone. fitTextPerWidget was NOT used and is still false: this host declares one widget per field, so per-widget fitting measures the identical rectangle and would have changed nothing.
whatChanged.selfHelpStop: registryGuidanceTrackId: "vt_seal_18_to_21" added to this family's config, which is the one word the host's FIX04 comment says each family needs once its repair is claimed. The family now reads ITS OWN committed registry track through the same code path vt_seal_pardon-set already used, and participant-instructions.md gains the 'When to stop and get a lawyer' section carrying all 11 of the track's selfHelpStopConditions verbatim, the sentence naming a scheduled hearing as where this packet's self-help ends, and the 'What has to be true before this petition can succeed' section carrying the track's 4 waitingPeriods and 6 exclusions verbatim. Nothing was written that the registry does not say and no condition was softened, shortened or paraphrased; the change to the file is purely additive (git diff shows insertions only).
alsoChangedAsAConsequence: reports/rendered-artifacts.json: the two fixture digests and byte lengths, and a componentSet block the family did not carry before (the registry's four declared packet-set components, each named and marked delivered). This lane does not claim COMPONENT_SET on it; it is named here because it is a change this rebuild made.
raster/canonical/page-03/page.png and raster/boundary/page-03/page.png: the builder's own page rasters for the one page whose bytes moved.
whatChanged.notChanged: suppressSynthesizedAppearances and fitAppearancesToRect are exactly as FIX67 left them (git diff of the host shows no line touching either). No FEE_AND_WAIVER text was touched anywhere; for vt_seal_dui-set the fee-and-waiver section of participant-instructions.md is byte-identical to the file at base, proved by diff.
